name: Cessna 206/207 Stationair
summary: Six-seat high-wing utility single (seven/eight-seat in stretched 207 form), a workhorse for skydiving, bush flying, cargo and floatplane operations.

wings: High wing braced by a single lift strut per side
Constant-chord inner section with tapered outer panels
engines: Big six-cylinder engine in a deep cowling
fuselage: Long six-seat cabin with three windows per side
Wide double cargo doors on the right rear fuselage
Fixed tricycle gear; the 207 is visibly stretched with an extra window

tellTales: Strut-braced high wing on a long cabin with three windows per side
Wide double cargo doors on the right rear fuselage
Big, deep nose with a three-blade prop

confusedWith.howToTell: The 206 has a longer cabin with an extra rear window and a big double cargo door on the right; the 182 has a shorter four-seat cabin.
The Caravan is much larger with a long turboprop nose, exhaust stack and usually an under-belly cargo pod; the 206 has a piston cowl and no pod.
The Kodiak has a long turboprop nose and a very large square-topped fin; the 206 has a piston cowl and a swept fin.
The 206 is smaller with a shorter cabin and a lower body; the GippsAero GA8 has a much taller, longer, boxier fuselage.
